title: Provisional broad Mumbai supply
description: First runnable baseline; provisional parameters are explicit and are not calibrated observations.

A.baseline.dedicated_transit_headway_s.description: Provisional dedicated-link service envelope. Flow capacity derives as maximum mapped vehicle PCU times 3600/headway, preserving any greater mapped capacity. This avoids interpreting a train headway as car-equivalent flow and is not a validated signalling capacity. Moved from RUN.smoke.dedicated_transit_headway_s on 21 September 2026 (9.204): the launch path is the harness, and the field is read by the build step that assembles the scenario.
A.baseline.dedicated_transit_headway_s.sweep_basis: Dedicated-mode headway sensitivity; replace with observed sectional signalling and vessel constraints.

A.baseline.inputs.description: The prepared baseline inputs the scenario assembly reads: the mapped regional network and combined feed (one pt2matsim build), the citywide plans written at B.population.plans_build_fraction from the synthesised core population (build_plans.py, 9.205), the boarding-fare table and the hired-fleet derivation. The assembly writes scenarios/matsim/BASE/, demand/plans/matsim/population_WEEKDAY.xml.gz and the plans report the launcher reads for the build fraction. fleet_assignments is the per-vehicle capacity assignment build_transit_fleet.py writes beside the mapped feed (9.206): the assembly resolves every mapped vehicle's seats and standing places through it, never copying the mapper's default capacities.

A.baseline.network_mode_sources.description: Provisional goods modes share their source network, with connected components audited. Detailed HGV and freight operating restrictions remain incomplete. Moved from RUN.smoke.network_mode_sources on 21 September 2026 (9.204): the launch path is the harness, and the field is read by the build step that assembles the scenario.

A.baseline.road_capacity_factors.description: Declared class sensitivity factors on the already mapped network. Identity preserves source capacities; this is not population sampling or evidence of correct road capacity. Geometry, lanes, speed and service departures are retained. Moved from RUN.smoke.road_capacity_factors on 21 September 2026 (9.204): the launch path is the harness, and the field is read by the build step that assembles the scenario.
A.baseline.road_capacity_factors.sweep_basis: Provisional flow-capacity sensitivity envelope, not fitted or observed Mumbai capacities.

A.baseline.road_mode_exclusions.description: Coarse class-based availability pending refined corridor access rules. Moved from RUN.smoke.road_mode_exclusions on 21 September 2026 (9.204): the launch path is the harness, and the field is read by the build step that assembles the scenario.

A.baseline.transit_mode_aliases.description: Mapped metro track permission uses light_rail; mapped metro vehicle profiles use subway. Moved from RUN.smoke.transit_mode_aliases on 21 September 2026 (9.204): the launch path is the harness, and the field is read by the build step that assembles the scenario.

A.baseline.transit_timing.description: Provisional moving-speed caps and intermediate-stop dwell derive physically feasible timetable offsets from the mapped path. Later source times are retained; no observed timetable is overwritten. Moved from RUN.smoke.transit_timing on 21 September 2026 (9.204): the launch path is the harness, and the field is read by the build step that assembles the scenario.
A.baseline.transit_timing.sweep_basis: Provisional broad behavioural baseline; validate with observed choices before calibration.

A.fare.boarding_representation.description: Whether pt boardings are charged from a per-route boarding-fare table (citysim.BoardingFareHandler; `table`) assembled beside the scenario network as boarding_fares.csv, or not (`absent`). `table` for this city: the published BEST, NMMT, suburban-rail, metro and ferry tariffs are transcribed per route into params/baseline/boarding_fares.csv (build_baseline_fares.py) and the harness refuses a scenario that lost its table.

A.fare.boarding_route_choice.description: Price each candidate transit boarding with the same city fare table and person-specific money utility as executed scoring, before RAPTOR prunes paths. This enables a mechanism, not a calibrated preference. Moved from RUN.smoke.boardingFare.routeChoice on 21 September 2026 (9.204): one key per MATSim parameter, under the framework's fare vocabulary.

A.network.freespeed_factor.description: Use declared or tagged free speed without an extra multiplier.

A.network.keep_paths.description: Baseline converter switch. Geometry reduction is permitted for the broad behavioural prototype; detailed node controls remain a declared limitation.

A.network.keep_tags_as_attributes.description: Converter representation switch for the broad baseline.

A.network.keep_ways_with_public_transit.description: Converter representation switch for the broad baseline.

A.network.max_link_length_m.description: Provisional maximum reduced link length; whole source geometry remains available.
A.network.max_link_length_m.sweep_basis: Provisional broad-baseline range; not a measured Mumbai calibration interval.

A.network.parse_turn_restrictions.description: Converter representation switch for the broad baseline.

A.network.path_access_overrides.description: Existing explicit path-tag parser vocabulary. Conditional and purpose-specific restrictions remain separate evidence.

A.network.path_modes_by_class.description: Baseline active-travel graph vocabulary; explicit path access tags are applied afterwards.

A.network.railway_speed_default_kmh.description: Provisional track free speeds; scheduled travel times will provide service timing. Not observed train operating speeds.

A.network.routable_subnetworks.description: Retain distinct active and transit subnetworks for later mode assembly.

A.road.capacity_default.description: Provisional class queue capacities. Used to enable congestion feedback to traveller decisions; not calibrated saturation flows.
A.road.capacity_default.sweep_basis: Provisional broad-baseline range; not a measured Mumbai calibration interval.

A.road.lanes_default.description: Provisional per-direction lane counts where OSM lacks lane tags. Tagged values take precedence; corridor refinement deferred.
A.road.lanes_default.sweep_basis: Provisional broad-baseline range; not a measured Mumbai calibration interval.

A.road.speed_default.description: Provisional class free speeds where OSM has no usable speed. Broad supply baseline authorised on 19 September 2026; not observed speeds. Tagged OSM speed takes precedence.
A.road.speed_default.sweep_basis: Provisional broad-baseline range; not a measured Mumbai calibration interval.
